**CROWN HEIGHTS — FRANKLIN AVENUE’S OPEN STREETS event on Saturday** transformed the stretch between St. Marks Avenue and Eastern Parkway into a carefree, car-free zone.

Part of NYC DOT’s 2025 Open Streets program, the event featured a Brooklyn celebrity pop-up, a giveaway by Brooklyn Book Bodega, an author book signing, one-man band and street performer Murimi Yuma and more.
